items.title: A magnitude 5.6 earthquake strikes Karnali Province, Nepal, killing at least 157 people and injuring over 300 more. Several houses are destroyed.
Federal Reserve rate decision: raised by 0.75 point, to a 3.75-4.00% target range (effective 2022-11-03)
Russia reports a record for the second consecutive day of 1,189 deaths from COVID-19, thereby bringing the nationwide death toll to 242,060.
Hurricane Eta (2020) peaked at Category 4, 130-knot winds and 922 hPa, making landfall 4 times
At least 17 co-ordinated explosions across a widespread area of Baghdad kill 113 people and wound more than 271.
M 7.0 - 93 km NNE of Naze, Japan
